intro: Vector Institute's Remarkable conference returns, where groundbreaking research meets real-world innovation. Two days bring together world-class researchers, industry innovators and emerging talent to show how Canada's AI leadership is taking shape on the global stage.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Research & keynotes
days.body: Immerse yourself in cutting-edge AI research as global pioneers and emerging talent share their latest breakthroughs through visionary keynotes and technical presentations.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: From research to real-world impact
days.body: See how industry leaders turn AI research into real-world solutions through hands-on workshops, lightning talks and poster sessions.

speakers_note: 2026 speakers used as stand-ins; bios are placeholder text

speakers.name: Nick Frosst
speakers.title: Co-founder
speakers.bio: Nick Frosst is Co-founder of Cohere, which builds large language models for enterprise use. At Remarkable, Nick will share what it takes to move generative AI from prototype to production.

speakers.name: Priyank Jaini
speakers.title: Research Scientist
speakers.bio: Priyank Jaini is a Research Scientist at Google DeepMind working on machine learning research. Priyank's talk will look at how new modelling approaches can make AI systems more reliable.

speakers.name: Ankita Upadhyay
speakers.title: Senior Director, AI Enablement
speakers.bio: Ankita Upadhyay leads AI enablement at Thomson Reuters, helping teams put AI to work across products and operations. Ankita will cover practical lessons from scaling AI inside a global company.

speakers.name: Chris Maddison
speakers.title: Faculty Member
speakers.bio: Chris Maddison is a Faculty Member at the Vector Institute whose research focuses on machine learning methods. Chris will discuss open questions at the frontier of AI research.

speakers.name: Alán Aspuru-Guzik
speakers.title: Faculty Member
speakers.bio: Alán Aspuru-Guzik is a Faculty Member at the Vector Institute working where AI meets chemistry and materials science. Alán's talk will explore how AI-driven labs can speed up discovery.

speakers.name: Glenda Crisp
speakers.title: President & CEO
speakers.bio: Glenda Crisp is President and CEO of the Vector Institute. Glenda will open Remarkable 2027 with a look at Canada's AI ecosystem and where it goes next.
